t: The mutton biryani is the closest thing to my grandmother's cooking I've found outside home. Seeraga samba rice done right.
Chettinad chicken with a heat that builds slowly — proper, honest cooking. The kothu parotta is unmissable.
We ordered the family biryani for a get-together and everyone asked where it was from. Generous cuts, great aroma.
Vanjaram fish fry was fresh and crisp. Service was warm and quick even on a busy Sunday.
Finally a non-veg place that treats its vegetarian dishes seriously. The paneer butter masala is rich and balanced.
Tandoori chicken with real charcoal smoke and a jigarthanda to finish. A proper Kongu-style meal.
